speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, and weight loss along with an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node. Can you tell me if you have experienced any changes in your bowel habits, such as diarrhea or constipation, and if the abdominal pain is localized to a specific area?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of tuberculosis exposure, and have you noticed any swelling in your groin or armpits? I also need to know if you have been coughing or experiencing shortness of breath.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: CT Abdomen_Pelvis
REQUEST TEST: Lymph Node Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CT Scan Thorax and Abdomen: Massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes. Cervical Lymph Node Biopsy: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results showing CD20-positive lymphocytes with a high proliferative index confirm a B-cell malignancy, most likely Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma. DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
